title: Schur number S(6), lower bound
statement: Colour 1, 2, ..., n with 6 colours so that no colour holds a solution of x + y = z, with n as large as possible; it shows S(6) >= n. The best known lower bound is S(6) >= 538, by McKenna (2026); a colouring of 1..539 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the colours of 1..n in order, digits 0..5 (whitespace ignored).
score: n, the length of the colouring; it proves S(6) >= n (larger is better)

best_known.source: S(6) >= 538: A. McKenna, The sixth Schur number is at least 538, Zenodo (4 Nov 2026), in Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit a5bbf82 (9 Nov 2026); read 9 Nov 2026; before it 537 (Chen, Zhu and Long, Oct 2026) and 536 (Fredricksen and Sweet 2000)

provenance.keeper: Leaps in Bounds, Schur and weak Schur numbers
